paragraphs.text: On Friday, the students at Willow School opened a repair corner in the library. Instead of throwing away broken items, they invited neighbours to bring them in. Mia, a retired engineer, showed students how to repair a loose chair leg. After the session, the chair was safe to use again.

The corner opens every Saturday morning. Visitors pay nothing, but they are encouraged to explain how an item was damaged. The club keeps a small notebook of repairs so that new members can learn from earlier mistakes.

questions.stem: Why does the club keep a notebook of repairs?

options.A: To record how much visitors pay.
options.B: To help new members learn from past work.

questions.stem: Which title best describes the passage?

options.C: A Repair Corner That Shares Skills
options.D: A School Replaces All Its Chairs
